help.text:
Here's what I can do:

/start — welcome message and player button
/help — this help
/cinema — CineNest online cinema
/videos — My videos: edit a download and your own photos

🎧 WavePlayer — a player with My Wave, likes and playlists.
🎞 My videos — trim, crop and export a file you downloaded, or edit a photo.
🔗 Video downloads: send a link ({sources}). Files up to 50 MB arrive right in the chat (up to 720p); for bigger ones you get a link valid for 1 hour. Up to 3 downloads at a time, 30 per day. Playlists, live streams and DRM-protected content are not downloaded.
link.not_implemented:
⏳ Downloading isn't enabled on the server right now. The link looks right, I recognised it ({source}).

Meanwhile, enjoy some music in WavePlayer.
link.unavailable: ⚠️ Downloading is temporarily unavailable. Please try again a bit later — everything else works.
link.invalid: 🤔 I couldn't parse that link. Make sure it was copied completely.
link.unsupported: This site isn't supported yet. Supported: {sources}.
link.rate_limited: 🐢 Too many requests. Please wait a little and try again.
link.error: 😕 Something went wrong. Please try again later.
text.hint: Send me a video link or open the player 👇
command.unknown: I don't know that command. Try /help.
cinema.open:
🎬 CineNest — online cinema: catalog, Watch later, resume where you left off.

It runs on a demo catalog for now; real movies arrive with the streaming stage.
videos.open: 🎞 My videos — downloads you can trim and export, plus your own photos.
link.playlist: 📃 I don't download playlists — send a link to a single video.
link.quota_active: 🚦 You already have 3 downloads in progress. Wait for one to finish and send the link again.
link.quota_daily: 📅 Daily download limit reached (30 per day). Try again tomorrow.
dl.too_big: ✅ {title} is downloaded, but the file ({size}) exceeds Telegram's bot upload limit ({limit}). Download it via the link — valid for 1 hour:
dl.too_big_no_link: ✅ {title} is downloaded, but the file ({size}) exceeds Telegram's bot upload limit ({limit}), and download links are not configured on this server.
dl.error.unavailable: 🚫 The video is unavailable: removed or the link is wrong.
dl.error.private: 🔒 The video is private or requires sign-in — I can't download it.
dl.error.drm_protected: 🛡 The video is DRM-protected — I don't download such content.
dl.error.geo_blocked: 🌍 The video isn't available in the server's region.
dl.error.bot_check: 🤖 The source asked to prove I'm not a robot. Please try later.
dl.error.rate_limited: 🐢 The source is rate-limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
dl.error.network: 📡 Download failed because of a network error. Please try again later.
dl.error.too_large: 📏 The video is too long or too big (limit: 3 hours / 2 GB).
dl.error.live: 🔴 This is a live stream or premiere — it can't be downloaded yet. Send the link after it ends.
dl.error.internal: 😕 Couldn't download “{title}”. Please try again later.
